name: Axelera Metis AIPU

flops.basis_detail: Axelera Metis AIPU product page states 'Up to 214 TOPs @ INT8' compute density from a single Metis AIPU.

notes: REAL VENDOR: Axelera AI (Eindhoven, Netherlands). Set to 'asic-other' because the schema enum does not include 'axelera'. Metis is Axelera's edge AI processing unit utilizing a digital In-Memory Computing (D-IMC) engine. Axelera claims peak compute density of up to 214 TOPS INT8 from a single Metis AIPU, operating at 15 TOPS/W efficiency with a typical power consumption of 10W. Available in PCIe card and M.2 module formats. Supported by the Axelera Voyager SDK software stack, providing compilation for models trained in PyTorch and ONNX (compatible with local-onnxruntime-mobile and ExecuTorch workflows).\nMEMORY CAPACITY AND BANDWIDTH: STILL NULL, AND HERE IS PRECISELY WHAT WAS LOOKED FOR (2026-10-11). Axelera does not publish on-board LPDDR memory capacity, bus width, or memory bandwidth on the primary product page. Because Metis relies heavily on in-memory compute tiles with local SRAM rather than conventional large external DRAM pools, DRAM bandwidth is not advertised as a primary spec. No values were back-computed.
